title: The Powderkeg
description: Kravenstal is at a breaking point. The strike may be over but the conditions that caused it are worse. A mother is holding a coughing child in Foundry Square and waiting to see if you will govern for her.

title: Budget Allocation — Emergency Review
description: Kravenstal needs resources. Adjust the budget to respond to the crisis on the ground.

title: The Reform Committee — Follow-Up
description: Theron's draft is circulating. The Halvekist bloc has filed seventeen proposed amendments. Each one is designed to make the document collapse under its own contradictions.

title: The Journalist's Questions
description: Nadia Voss left a message. She's been told the budget process is 'under review.' She'd like to know what that means — on the record.

title: The Currency Run
description: The Kroner is in freefall. Citizens are panicking. Vostane needs emergency powers.
